new_value: Mark, 2026-11-15: URI. A refusal reason is a URI naming the condition, as RFC 9457 problem types are (matches #204). Proposal for the spec: URNs under an IETF-registered namespace, urn:ietf:params:mimi:reason:<name> (RFC 3553), with an IANA registry of names; implementations may also use their own URIs (e.g. tag: or https:) for local reasons, and a receiver that doesn't know one treats the response by its result code alone. mimid until the WG decides: tag:reviewcommit.com,2026:mimid:reason:<name>, alongside its existing tag: problem types (src/http.rs PROBLEM_TYPE_PREFIX), marked INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC.
